'''Brodogon Consortium''' was a business entity that operated from a [[Brodogon Consortium headquarters|station]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Consortium purchased [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from [[Krayn]].
